Name: Purple and Dirty Blonde Maru Pallet Swap
Author: MrBuddGaming
Description:
An Identical Version of https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1453 but as a Standalone mod, with Sprite and Portrait work, being a complete Pallet Swap with  the Original Art Style.

A Combination of the Spritework base made by CassandraRose

and Portraitwork, done by malletgirl

All credit going to them for the work, be sure to check out CassandraRose's other works.

Downloads.Description: A Maru that has Dirty Blonde Hair, a Purple Shirt, and Light Blue overalls, to replace over the Original Sprites, complete with a README.txt, and the original sprites and portraits.
